headline: YouTube adds AI custom feeds and new comment features
summary: YouTube is rolling out AI-powered custom feeds that let viewers describe what they want to see, using Gemini to build a personalized page. The platform is also adding GIF replies, voice-powered TV comments, personalized moderation, and paid members-only communities to make comments more engaging for creators and fans.

sources.quote: ouTube’s new custom feeds let users describe the videos they want to see in their own words, then use Gemini to build a personalized feed around the request.
